title: Roles
description: What each role grants and where it can be bound: the roles part of plat5.yml.

roles.title: roles
roles.description: Map of slug → role. At least one role.

creator_role.title: creator_role
creator_role.description: Required. What the creator of a node gets on it, where its kind binds its creator (`bind_creator`). Bindable at every kind.

custom_roles.title: custom_roles
custom_roles.description: Optional. Enables root-scoped custom roles managed through identity's API alongside predefined roles. Default `false`.

permissions.title: permissions
permissions.description: Optional map of permission → metadata (`description`, `bindable_at`, `custom_role_assignable`) augmenting the permission catalog derived from routes and kinds for custom roles.

description.title: description
description.description: Optional human-readable description shown by the permissions catalog API.

bindable_at.title: bindable_at
bindable_at.description: Optional kinds where custom roles holding this permission may be bound. Omitted allows any kind.

custom_role_assignable.title: custom_role_assignable
custom_role_assignable.description: Whether org custom roles may include this permission. Default `true`.

permissions.title: permissions
permissions.description: `[a-z0-9:._-]+`, max 64 chars, unique, max 64 permissions. `["*"]` grants every permission; `*` is valid only alone.

includes.title: includes
includes.description: Other roles whose permissions this one grants too, transitively. Only permissions are included: `bindable_at` stays the role's own.

bindable_at.title: bindable_at
bindable_at.description: Required. The kinds this role can be bound at.
